points.point: Vault 的實際 RFIC/半導體案例：Samsung Foundry RF/Analog Enablement Group，DUT 為 5G SoC including VCO，使用 FSWP50（analyzer）+ SMW200A 44GHz / SGS100A（signal generator）
points.label: missing
points.why: No Samsung Foundry RF/Analog case, DUT 5G SoC/VCO, FSWP50 or SGS100A stated

points.point: 該案例的量測在 probe station 上進行，並搭配自動化 VCO tuning 軟體，顯示儀器位於晶片級 characterization / validation 這一步
points.label: missing
points.why: No probe station, automated VCO tuning software, or chip-level characterization step

points.point: 測試區塊對儀器類別的 mapping：RefClk 與 PLL jitter performance 由 phase noise analyzers 與 signal generators 負責
points.label: missing

points.point: ADC / DAC frontend performance 由 spectrum analyzers 與 signal generators 負責，是 signal generator / analyzer 在高速數位 / 混訊晶片驗證中的另一個落點
points.label: missing
points.why: No ADC/DAC frontend mapping to spectrum analyzers and signal generators

points.point: RFIC 的 bare board / socket / transmission line 評估這一段，來源明示的 fit 是 VNAs，而非 signal generator / analyzer
points.label: missing
points.why: No statement that RFIC bare board/socket/transmission-line evaluation fits VNAs rather than signal generator/analyzer

points.point: 2026.7 DDT success stories 把 SoC testing 對應到 FSWP、SMA100B（RF and Microwave Signal Generator）與 ZNA67
points.label: missing
points.why: No DDT SoC testing mapping to FSWP, SMA100B, and ZNA67

points.point: Vault 明示不推論這些儀器在各應用中的角色分工（stimulus / analysis / phase noise / VNA / automation），因此「流程位置」只能到 mapping 層級
points.label: contradicted
points.why: Answer assigns workflow/role details such as stimulus and analysis, while reference says Vault does not infer such role分工 and only supports mapping-level placement

points.point: Samsung 案例被歸納為可包裝成 RF / analog enablement 測試方案，但軟體正式名稱與版本未標示
points.label: missing
points.why: No RF/analog enablement packaging point or note that software name/version is unmarked

invented: test → debug → validation part of a broader Virtual tester workflow
Signal Generator is the stimulus/source side
Signal Analyzer or spectrum analyzer is the measurement/analysis side
RF-characteristic measurements such as G/T, noise figure, transmit power, link-equation validation, modulation/coding analysis
